_comment: Extension points of the product ZCA_OPS (docs/EXTENDING_WITH_CUSTOMER_DATA.md): every place where a customer adds its own data on top of what the product reads from SAP standard, and the mechanism it uses there. Checked by tools/extensions.py --check (house check extensions): every file named exists, every document named mentions its object, every view of a CDS extension point carries exactly the annotations below and its anchor elements, no other product view is extensible, and the matrix of the document is generated from this file. Mechanisms: config (a configuration row), registry (the customer layer of the link registry), generated (a spec in the customer folder, generated code in the customer package), plugin (a customer class of a product interface), extension (extend view entity in the customer package, generated by tools/extensions.py from config/extensions/*.json).

points.standard: SAP standard objects of the layers S4CORE (released views, bank statement, partner) and FICA (FI-CA tables)
points.description: Customer layer: its tables and views, custom fields on standard tables, its links, switch-off and replacement of a standard link
points.example: Custom field ZZXX_REQ_ID on DFKKOP and the link item -> request (config/links/examples/xx_overlay.json)

points.standard: Delivered checks of the product (SAP standard tables, released views)
points.description: Register a delivered check for the customer's area with its thresholds
points.example: The break check ZCL_CA_OPS_CHK_BREAK registered in the customer's area

points.standard: Any approved table: FI-CA tables or the customer's own tables
points.description: Count / sum / age over a table approved for the area (ZCA_OPS_TABWL), without code
points.example: Requests in status PENDING older than one day in the customer's request table

points.standard: Whatever the check reads (read-only)
points.description: A customer check class where a configuration row cannot express the rule
points.example: A check that compares the customer's request log with the FI-CA items

points.standard: SAP standard processes of the packages S4CORE and FI-CA
points.description: Customer layer of the catalogue: activation of standard processes, its own processes
points.example: config/catalogue/examples of the framework

points.standard: The product contract; the G/L side on released journal views
points.description: Mapping spec: which customer table holds a payment, a request, an attempt; adapter views generated into the customer package; feeder systems and texts as rows of ZCA_OPS_FEEDER / ZCA_OPS_PMDIM
points.example: Customer XX with requests from a claims and a billing system (section 3 of the document)

points.standard: Journal lines (ACDOCA) of the clearing accounts
points.description: Accounts, buckets and ordered bucket rules of the customer's area
points.example: A bucket for the customer's bank cumulation

points.standard: Journal lines (ACDOCA) of the clearing accounts
points.description: A LINK condition follows a registry link from the line to a customer object to explain the break
points.example: The line's assignment leads to the bank line and its transaction code

points.standard: Released I_JournalEntryItem, I_CompanyCode; FI-CA documents
points.description: Flows, accounts by role, stages, tiles, stage controls and stage rules of the customer
points.example: The customer's disbursement flow with its clearing accounts

points.standard: Open items the product cannot see
points.description: A customer source of what explains an account's balance
points.example: Requests in flight in the customer's request table

points.standard: FI-CA payment runs (DPAYH), SAP background jobs (TBTCO)
points.description: File types, milestones and deadlines, status mappings and adapters of the customer
points.example: The customer's acceptance deadline of 10:00 on the next business day

points.standard: Middleware, bank acknowledgements, schedulers and ticketing the product cannot see
points.description: A customer source of files, transfers, bank answers, jobs or statements, a ticket sink, a calendar
points.example: The bank acknowledgement table of the customer

points.standard: SAP background jobs and their logs
points.description: Which jobs belong to one run of an application
points.example: The worker jobs of a parallel processing run

points.standard: SAP background jobs and their logs
points.description: Business context of a failed job from the customer's tables
points.example: The payment run and company code of a failed payment job

points.standard: The framework's own scheduler job configuration (ZCA_OPS_JOBSCH) with a business calendar
points.description: The external scheduler's plan of expected runs (and the calendar of a configured plan)
points.example: A reader of the scheduler's daily plan export

points.standard: Parent job and parallel jobs of a FI-CA mass activity run from SAP's job tables
points.description: The runs of a mass activity with their intervals and their state
points.example: A reader of the mass activity's own run and interval records

points.standard: Findings of every check
points.description: Alert rules and channels of the customer's area
points.example: Mail to the customer's payment team on a new break

points.standard: Findings of every check
points.description: A section of the alert mail with the customer's own content
points.example: The open requests of the customer's feeder in the morning mail

points.standard: Findings of every check
points.description: A delivery channel of the customer
points.example: The customer's ticket queue

points.standard: The product's stored results
points.description: Retention of the customer's own stored results under the product's purge
points.example: The customer's daily snapshot table

points.standard: Findings of every check
points.description: Runbook links and correlation rules of the customer's checks
points.example: The customer's runbook page of a check

points.standard: Stored results of the checks a control covers
points.description: The customer's controls, their checks and cut-off times
points.example: The customer's daily reconciliation control

points.standard: Delivered parameter definitions with defaults
points.description: Values of the customer's area; the customer's own parameter definitions
points.example: BRK_UNEXPLAINED_DAYS for the customer's area

points.standard: Findings of the product's checks (ZCA_OPS_FINDING), which read SAP standard and approved tables
points.description: Exceptions list and object page
points.example: The feeder and received date of the customer's request an exception is about

points.standard: Journal lines (ACDOCA) of the clearing accounts, grouped by assignment and currency (snapshot ZCA_OPS_BRKGRP)
points.description: Break list, cube and query
points.example: The worklist state and source system of the payment document in the assignment

points.standard: Journal lines (ACDOCA) of a break group (snapshot ZCA_OPS_BRKITM), the released I_JournalEntryItem by its key
points.description: Lines of a break (object page table)
points.example: The customer's reference of the journal line from its own table

points.standard: Released I_JournalEntryItem, I_CompanyCode, I_FiscalCalendarDate; FI-CA documents (DFKKOP, DFKKOPK, DFKKKO)
points.description: Account flow cube and query (rows by stage, columns by account)
points.example: The customer's owner team of a stage or its own name of an account

points.standard: Stage configuration and the latest results of the stage checks
points.description: Stage card with control tags
points.example: The customer's service level of a stage

points.standard: Latest run and open findings of every registered check
points.description: Status per check (list and object page)
points.example: The customer's support group of a check

points.standard: SAP standard processes of the catalogue packages with their activation
points.description: Process catalogue (list and object page)
points.example: The customer's process owner and its own process reference

points.standard: Controls and the stored results of the checks they cover
points.description: Daily control review (list and object page)
points.example: The customer's audit reference and tester of a control

points.standard: Payment file register of the product (ZCA_OPS_PFFILE), fed from FI-CA payment runs and the adapters
points.description: Payment file worklist (list report and object page)
points.example: The customer's own file name or business line of a file
